quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #13
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road joins from the right ahead.

questions.question: Which light tells you to slow down and be careful at an intersection?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, look both ways, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, it:

options.text: Begins to metabolize itself more quickly.
Decreases the number of driving errors.

questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your blood, it slows your reactions, makes you feel more confident, and causes you to make more mistakes.

questions.question: Which is the safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down as you enter, speed up as you exit.
Maintain a constant speed throughout the curve.
Speed up as you enter, slow down as you exit.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down as you enter, speed up as you exit.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you enter a curve. Speed up gradually as you exit. Speeding up as you enter makes it hard to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: May be ignored in rainy, snowy, or icy conditions.
Shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: These signs show a recommended speed for curves and turns. You should follow the speed even in good weather. In rain, snow, or ice, slow down even more.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your reflexes and reaction time slow down.
Your judgement of speed and distance is distorted.
You calm down and can concentrate better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You calm down and can concentrate better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows reaction time, reduces vision, changes your sense of speed and distance, reduces recovery from headlight glare, and makes you take more risks. It does not help you calm down or concentrate better.

questions.question: Car drivers should know that large trucks:

options.text: Can stop more quickly than passenger vehicles.
Do not need more room to maneuver than passenger vehicles.

questions.explanation: Large trucks have large blind spots in front, on the sides, and in the rear. Do not stay in these areas. Trucks need more room to turn and stop than cars.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: Larger vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: The bigger the vehicle, the bigger the blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs have areas near the rear that cannot be seen in mirrors.

questions.question: How alcohol affects your reflexes and judgment:

options.text: Is less pronounced when consuming beer instead of wine.
Is less pronounced when consuming wine instead of beer.
Is most pronounced when consuming hard ciders and mixed drinks.
Depends on the amount of alcohol in your bloodstream.

questions.correctAnswerText: Depends on the amount of alcohol in your bloodstream.
questions.explanation: All types of alcohol affect your reflexes and judgment the same way. The type does not matter—only how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines. What may you do?

options.text: Cross the lines only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross the lines to pass other vehicles if there is no oncoming traffic.
Cross the lines only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross the lines only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing is allowed from either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: How far must you stay away from a fire hydrant when parking?
questions.explanation: Never park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. Park only in legal spots where other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two one-way roads separated by a median. You must stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots when changing lanes?

options.text: Use both the inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Always turn your head to check your blind spots before changing lanes.

questions.question: When must you yield for emergency vehicles?

options.text: When you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any emergency vehicle using flashing lights or a siren.

questions.question: What are signs called that require drivers to follow a specific instruction?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. Breaking these rules can result in a penalty.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn when this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line between traffic mean?

options.text: You may pass if it is safe.
Both lanes go in the same direction.
You may pass even if it is dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions. A single dashed yellow line means both directions can pass. Only pass if it is safe and you will not hit oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: About ____ percent of crashes involve alcohol.
questions.explanation: Alcohol makes it harder to drive safely. Everyone drives worse after drinking, even if they seem fine. About 38 percent of all traffic deaths involve alcohol.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert drivers about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: Which medications could have negative side effects that affect driving ability?
questions.explanation: Any medication can affect your driving ability. Ask your doctor or pharmacist how your medicine may affect driving. Check the labels on over-the-counter medicines to see if they can impair your driving.

questions.question: When turning left, drivers must yield the right-of-way to:

options.text: Other drivers who are already in the intersection.
Pedestrians who are already in the intersection.

questions.explanation: When turning left, yield to oncoming traffic. Always yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers who are already in the intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They show drivers what road conditions and hazards are coming. This sign tells you that a lane is ending. Get ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: You may drive around or under a gate that is being lowered or raised at a railroad crossing:

options.text: As long as an approaching train is not too close.
If your vehicle can do so without damaging the gate.
If you first look carefully in both directions.

questions.explanation: Flashing red lights, lowered gates, and bells at a railroad crossing mean you must stop completely. Do not cross the tracks until the lights and bells stop and the gates are fully raised. Never drive around or under a moving gate.

questions.question: While driving on a two-lane road without bicycle lanes, you encounter a bicyclist traveling in the same direction. What is the safest way to pass the bicyclist?

options.text: Slow down and wait until there is no traffic approaching, then pass the bicyclist while leaving him or her sufficient space.
Continue driving straight. It is the bicyclist's responsibility to get out of your way.
Do not pass the bicyclist until you come to a traffic signal or stop sign.
Honk at the bicyclist to let him or her know you are about to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and wait until there is no traffic approaching, then pass the bicyclist while leaving him or her sufficient space.
questions.explanation: Pass a bicyclist the same way you would pass any other vehicle. Leave at least 3 feet of space between your mirror and the bicyclist. On faster roads or with multiple bicyclists, leave at least 5 feet. Avoid honking—it may startle riders and cause them to crash.

questions.question: A traffic light displaying a green arrow and a red light means that:

options.text: You may only drive straight ahead.
You may drive only in the direction of the green arrow.
You must wait for a solid green light to proceed in any direction.
Vehicles moving in any direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may drive only in the direction of the green arrow.
questions.explanation: A green arrow with a red light means you can only go in the direction of the arrow. The intersection must be clear before you proceed.

questions.question: About ____ of all traffic fatalities involve alcohol.
questions.explanation: Drinking and driving is illegal and dangerous. About 38 percent of all traffic deaths involve alcohol.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white, rectangular signs with black markings. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means it is illegal to pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see a:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop. Look both ways before moving forward.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. This lane is only for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: If your license has not been suspended before, it will be suspended for getting ____ points within three years.
questions.explanation: When you get a traffic ticket in North Carolina, points are added to your driving record. If you get 12 points within three years and your license has not been suspended before, your license will be suspended for 60 days.

questions.question: To drive safely at night, you should:

options.text: Not drive if you are tired.
Make sure your headlights are working properly.

questions.explanation: Night driving is harder because you cannot see as well. Do all these things to stay safe: stay farther back from other cars, do not drive if tired, and check that your headlights work.

questions.question: When backing up, you should:

options.text: Look over your shoulder to the rear window.
Rely only on a backup camera.
Put your head out of the window on the driver's side.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder to the rear window.
questions.explanation: When backing up, turn your head and look back through the rear window. Do not rely only on your mirror.
